mapper.select: SELECT max(sua.allocation_id) FROM fnd_org_position fop, fnd_employee_assigns fea, sys_user_allocation sua WHERE fop.position_type = 'LEGAL' AND fop.chief_position_flag != 'Y' AND fea.position_id = fop.position_id AND sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id AND sua.user_id not in ( SELECT s.user_id FROM sys_appoint_approver saa,sys_user_allocation s WHERE saa.sid_code = #{sidCode} AND saa.source_id = #{sourceId} AND upper(saa.source_table) = #{sourceTable} and s.allocation_id = saa.user_allocation_id and exists( select 1 from act_hi_comment t3, ACT_HI_TASKINST t4 where t3.PROC_INST_ID_ = saa.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID and t3.user_id_ = saa.user_allocation_id and t3.MESSAGE_ = 'APPROVED' and t3.TASK_ID_ = t4.id_ and t4.TASK_DEF_KEY_ = 'sid-nOumRDrm-26As-4h8m-8vc2-CjnzW2MHnNPk' and t3.TYPE_ = 'action' )) group by sua.user_id
SELECT sua.allocation_id FROM sys_user su, sys_user_allocation sua WHERE su.USER_NAME = 'jiangsisi' AND sua.user_id = su.USER_ID and rownum=1
SELECT sua.allocation_id FROM sys_user su, sys_user_allocation sua WHERE su.USER_NAME = 'luwuyang' AND sua.user_id = su.USER_ID and rownum=1
SELECT sua.allocation_id FROM sys_user su, sys_user_allocation sua WHERE su.USER_NAME = 'luwuyang' AND sua.user_id = su.USER_ID

SELECT max(sua.allocation_id) FROM fnd_org_position fop, fnd_employee_assigns fea, sys_user_allocation sua WHERE fop.position_type = 'LEGAL' AND fop.chief_position_flag != 'Y' AND fea.position_id = fop.position_id AND sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id AND sua.user_id not in ( SELECT s.user_id FROM sys_appoint_approver saa,sys_user_allocation s WHERE saa.sid_code = #{sidCode} AND saa.process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} and s.allocation_id = saa.user_allocation_id) group by sua.user_id
select sua.allocation_id as name from sys_user_allocation sua, sys_user su where sua.user_id = su.user_id and su.user_name = #{names} and rownum = 1
